speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I walked the close twice. The only prints before mine were a cat's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One window lit. The Mayor sits up. What keeps him from sleeping?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I tried a line at the door. The moon keeps the close, and every stone is sworn.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It sounded like a proclamation. It is not. The nose made it grand. I laughed.
